purpose: Collect a simple one-time donation through an approved payment gateway without creating a full ecommerce checkout.

fields.label: Donation Amount
fields.accessibility_notes: Visible label; suggested amounts may be separate choices or instructions.

fields.label: Donation Consent
fields.privacy_notes: Do not imply tax deductibility or recurring payments unless approved.

conditional_logic.rule: Payment feed only runs when amount is valid and consent is checked.

confirmations.name: Donation received
confirmations.message: Thank you for your support. Your payment receipt will be sent if the payment is successful.

notifications.name: Donation admin notification
notifications.message: Send limited donor/contact amount details after approved payment-notification timing is confirmed.

feeds.name: Stripe donation payment
feeds.condition: Run only after amount and consent validation.

spam_settings.turnstile: only if add-on and keys are confirmed

accessibility_settings.label_guidance: No placeholder-only fields; Total is visible before submission.

data_retention_notes: Donation entries include personal/payment metadata. Review consent wording, receipt data, export/erase handling, retention, and gateway transaction ownership before launch.
required_addons: Stripe Add-On or approved payment gateway add-on
risks: Payment feed, receipt wording, refund stance, gateway mode, SSL, and tax/deductibility claims require explicit approval before production.
